scope: Supplied 1.2 checklist, not historical 1.1 numbering. Evidence paths are relative to the evidence ZIP unless source or deliverable paths are explicit. PASS states only the scope described in each row.

rows.criterion: `npm ci` succeeds with the final lockfile.
rows.note: Registry DNS EAI_AGAIN and offline cache ENOTCACHED. Existing bundled bootstrap passes; it is not npm ci.

rows.criterion: TypeScript typecheck passes.
rows.note: Main application TypeScript check; optional installed React-PDF typecheck remains blocked in section I.

rows.criterion: Existing Node suite remains green (127 baseline tests, plus new tests).
rows.note: 127 supplied core cases retained; 49 new cases; 176/176 pass, zero skipped. Intentional public catalog is now 10 pages rather than 8.

rows.criterion: Release/private-content check passes; no private reference library leaks into public build.
rows.note: Reviewed public-only catalog, exact review hashes, original 8 stable page IDs retained. Actual PDF Atlas bytes are absent from source/build.

rows.criterion: DOM/browser hardening suite passes after intentional selector updates.
rows.note: 39/39 hardening UI and 14/14 baseline DOM cases; actual Chromium DOM with suppressed persistence. Normal-origin browser is separately BLOCKED.

rows.criterion: Reader 1.1 behavioral contracts remain intact unless explicitly superseded below.
rows.note: 18/18 reader behavior cases and existing core contracts pass for notes, Focus, Compare, native fallback, intake and private export. Does not certify real reload or integrated PDF.

rows.criterion: PDF preparation/authoring suite remains green.
rows.note: 12/12 actual offline PDF-authoring/processing and repository-builder checks on synthetic fixtures.

rows.criterion: Runtime normal-origin test survives reload with exact equality for notes, ratings, bookmarks, overlays, imports, assets AND `personal.session`.
rows.note: Normal HTTP navigation rejected by ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR before IndexedDB. Startup mutation fixed and two App-mount diffs are empty, but these do not certify page.reload().

rows.criterion: Runtime flow continues past reload and completes import-v2, idempotent reimport, backup download, fresh context, restore, restored exact state, restored reload and no-errors gates.
rows.note: Every production flow row remains blocked behind real_origin. No mock, skipped equality, or partial pipeline was counted as a pass.

rows.criterion: No test relaxation, storage mock or browser-policy workaround is accepted.
rows.note: Real-origin suite retains exact whole-session/record equality and no storage substitution. Separate DOM diagnostics explicitly do not close B01/B02. No browser-policy bypass.

rows.criterion: Visible `Knowledge Atlas`/`LOCAL` brand block no longer consumes the top ribbon.
rows.note: Routine top ribbon has mode/back/forward/search/AI export, no brand or LOCAL block.

rows.criterion: Global search occupies the primary top-bar area.
rows.note: Measured search width exceeds 80% on tested desktops and 55% at 390px.

rows.criterion: Export-to-AI is icon-only in routine chrome with accessible label/tooltip.
rows.note: Export icon has full accessible label and title tooltip.

rows.criterion: Compare is icon-only in routine chrome with accessible label/tooltip.
rows.note: Compare icon in rail has full accessible label and title tooltip.
All four required viewport geometry/overflow checks pass; full screenshots included.

rows.criterion: Context drawer overlays instead of shrinking the reader canvas.
rows.note: Exact reader bounding box unchanged when drawer opens; drawer overlays the canvas.

rows.criterion: Opening/closing Context does not alter reading anchor, split ratio, active pane or saved history.
rows.note: Whole in-memory session exactly unchanged across Context open/close; Escape returns trigger focus. Not a durable reload test.

rows.note: Required rail order/grouping; More anchored at bottom.

rows.note: Only reference metadata/tree in app; zero PDF Atlas pack assets. Original synthetic guide fixtures retained.

rows.note: Canonical HTTPS raw-content URLs, no blob HTML page links; live paths are staging and not verified hosted.

rows.criterion: final coordinator can pin all URLs to one pdfatlas commit in a single well-defined place.
rows.note: Single base URL config accepts final full commit; deterministic offline sync regenerates reviewed pack.

rows.criterion: only exact `raw.githubusercontent.com/julian-passebecq/pdfatlas/...` entries bypass the arbitrary-external consent gate.
rows.note: Exact repo/path + approved pack + reviewed hash, no query/credentials/redirect; bounded verified fetch. Controlled synthetic transport tests, not live hosting.

rows.criterion: arbitrary external PDFs still require consent.
rows.note: Arbitrary external references retain explicit consent; spoofed/mismatched inputs fail closed.
